purpose: Narrow source-shell namespace export/import/forget controls; expectation criteria are scaffolding, not observed answers.
channel: ASCII source-file shell ingress; result string length/index and scan %c are reported as decimal units in an ASCII-only row. No raw counted NativeString NUL, binary byte projection or physical object cache claim.
questions: Do exact source-produced adjacent surrogate units remain distinct in export filtering and imported callable names?
Does imported command-token identity survive source rename and does qualified forget compare the original source tail after local rename?
What native error/flag distinctions apply to missing, local and same-namespace imports, qualified exports, leading export clear and force replacement?

expectation_criteria.Jim: Actual source-name import/export behaviour must be observed separately; do not substitute C expectations.

output_schema: Each row is a Tcl list: case ID, catch code, string length, list of decimal scan-%c values for each string index. Numeric units are this provider’s measured string operations; they are not asserted to be raw bytes or a universal Unicode scalar representation.
